trs: She, this busy one of yours, she is already in the smokehouse checking the dried fish.'\footnote{Natalia Tylkanova's grandmother and the husband and wife had been secretly and somewhat sarcastically referring to half-blind Irina as the ``busy one'', since Irina did nothing all day, just sat around. trs: And these grannies smiled, they thought that was interesting.'\footnote{The grannies thought it was funny that a little child every evening listened to their constant questions about where Irina was going, and that in the end she couldn't hold back and spoke up, referring to the half-blind old woman by the sarcastic epithet ``busy one''. This kind of behaviour (a child making a judgement about an adult's behaviour) was, however, not really condoned, so the grannies didn't laugh out loud, only smiled a bit to themselves. The episode obviously made a deep impression on Natalija Tylkanova's grandmother, since she reminded her about it ten years later.
